autoboxing-unboxing-null-risk.title: Autoboxing and unboxing
autoboxing-unboxing-null-risk.short: Conversions between primitives and wrappers can be implicit
autoboxing-unboxing-null-risk.summary: Understand when Java boxes primitive values and unboxes wrapper objects.
autoboxing-unboxing-null-risk.why: Implicit unboxing of a null wrapper throws NullPointerException, so wrapper nullability matters.
autoboxing-unboxing-null-risk.tips: Prefer primitives when null has no meaning and check nullable wrappers before unboxing.

enumset-for-enum-flags.title: EnumSet for enum values
enumset-for-enum-flags.short: Use a specialized Set for enum constants
enumset-for-enum-flags.summary: EnumSet is a compact Set implementation designed specifically for enum values.
enumset-for-enum-flags.why: It expresses a group of enum constants directly while retaining normal Set operations.
enumset-for-enum-flags.tips: Use EnumSet.noneOf or EnumSet.of instead of integer bit flags when the domain is an enum.

map-merge-frequency-counter.title: Count values with Map.merge
map-merge-frequency-counter.short: Update a map entry in one operation
map-merge-frequency-counter.summary: Use Map.merge to initialize or combine a value for an existing key.
map-merge-frequency-counter.why: merge removes the need for a separate containsKey branch in many counters and accumulators.
map-merge-frequency-counter.tips: Keep the remapping function side-effect free when possible.

objects-requirenonnull-else-default.title: Choose a non-null default
objects-requirenonnull-else-default.summary: Return the first value when non-null or a required non-null default otherwise.
objects-requirenonnull-else-default.why: The method states the null fallback policy explicitly and rejects a null default.
objects-requirenonnull-else-default.tips: Use Optional when absence is part of a larger API model rather than a one-off null fallback.

classforname-classnotfound.title: Class.forName and ClassNotFoundException
classforname-classnotfound.short: Reflection lookup can fail at runtime
classforname-classnotfound.summary: Handle ClassNotFoundException when loading a class name dynamically.
classforname-classnotfound.why: A class name stored as text is not checked by the compiler and may be absent from the runtime class path.
classforname-classnotfound.tips: Prefer direct class references when dynamic loading is not actually required.

localdate-invalid-date-parse.title: Invalid calendar date parsing
localdate-invalid-date-parse.short: A well-shaped date can still be impossible
localdate-invalid-date-parse.summary: LocalDate parsing rejects dates such as February 30.
localdate-invalid-date-parse.why: DateTimeParseException covers both malformed text and values that cannot form a valid date.
localdate-invalid-date-parse.tips: Validate or report user input rather than silently correcting impossible dates.

static-method-type-parameter-scope.title: Class type parameter in a static method
static-method-type-parameter-scope.short: Static members cannot use an instance type parameter directly
static-method-type-parameter-scope.summary: Declare a method type parameter when a static generic method needs its own type variable.
static-method-type-parameter-scope.why: The class type parameter belongs to instances of the generic class, while a static method has no such instance.
static-method-type-parameter-scope.tips: Write static <U> U method(...) when the static method itself is generic.

lambda-overload-target-ambiguity.title: Ambiguous overloaded lambda target
lambda-overload-target-ambiguity.short: A lambda needs one target functional interface
lambda-overload-target-ambiguity.summary: Disambiguate overloaded methods when a lambda can match multiple functional interfaces.
lambda-overload-target-ambiguity.why: Lambda parameter and return shapes may not provide enough information to select one overload.
lambda-overload-target-ambiguity.tips: A cast or a separately typed variable can make the intended functional interface explicit.

unchecked-generic-array-cast-warning.title: Unchecked generic array cast
unchecked-generic-array-cast-warning.short: Generic arrays cannot be fully checked at runtime
unchecked-generic-array-cast-warning.summary: Avoid casting arrays to parameterized component types when a collection can model the data.
unchecked-generic-array-cast-warning.why: Type erasure prevents the runtime from verifying the full generic component type of the array.
unchecked-generic-array-cast-warning.tips: Prefer List<List<T>> or another generic collection for variable-sized generic groups.

arrays-aslist-primitive-array-trap.title: Arrays.asList with a primitive array
arrays-aslist-primitive-array-trap.short: A primitive array becomes one list element
arrays-aslist-primitive-array-trap.summary: Arrays.asList(int[]) produces a List<int[]> rather than a list of boxed integers.
arrays-aslist-primitive-array-trap.why: Generic varargs work with reference types, so the whole primitive array is inferred as the single reference argument.
arrays-aslist-primitive-array-trap.tips: Use an IntStream and box it when a List<Integer> is actually required.
